pages.title: Loading & Storage
pages.text: Hold a backpack and sneak-use an empty cargo slot to place it. Use a loaded backpack to open its own storage and settings screens, with any item in your hand.$(br2)Sneak-use the loaded backpack to return it to your inventory; overflow drops beside the wagon.

pages.title: Travelling with a Backpack
pages.text: Stored items and backpack settings remain with the backpack when the wagon changes form, the backpack is unloaded, or the wagon is dismantled.$(br2)With Carry On installed, allowed pickup attempts use its configured gesture first. Carrying a backpack with Carry On also lets you place it into an empty cargo slot.
